lessons_used: Evidence remains thin for single-test categories: adoption redesigns, adoption wait_info, finish layout/new_screen/redesign, home new_flow, and sign-in reordering.
Home wait_info changes are helpful, supported by 2 winning tests out of 4.
Choose_path redesigns (2 tests) and choose_path copy updates (2 tests) showed no positive effect, ranging from no effect to worse.
Adoption hints (3 tests), home redesigns (2 tests), sign-in copy updates (2 tests), and sign-in incentives (2 tests) showed no clear effect.
Finish hints (2 tests) and sign-in notifications (2 tests) showed no clear effect or performed worse.
Predictions were consistently too low for winning changes and too high for changes that had no clear effect or performed worse.

candidates.title: Sign-In Existing Account Email Lookup Hint
candidates.change: Adds an account lookup hint on the sign-in screen helping users verify their original login method to prevent accidental secondary account creation.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in, indicating users accidentally create fresh accounts with alternate emails.

sign_in.hint: Using an existing account? Ensure you use the same email to keep your saved pet.

components.text: Need help finding your existing account?

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Pet Animation Preview Display
candidates.change: Displays a live animated preview of pet idle actions on the waiting screen while background generation finishes.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean duration (2336s). Lessons learned show home wait_info changes are effective (2 out of 4 tested were winners).

waiting.headline: Your pet is coming to life...
waiting.body: Here is a sneak peek of your desktop companion while final files render.

guard.reason: Adds an animated pet preview to the waiting screen while maintaining the screen's core function of showing generation progress.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info is a proven category with 2 winning tests, though home step already has high completion (89.1%).

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Interaction Controls Video Showcase
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated onboarding end screen with short video clips showing how to drag, hide, summon, and talk to the pet on desktop.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails from users confused about how to interact with, hide, or control their pet after setup.

new_interaction_showcase.headline: How to Interact with Your Companion
new_interaction_showcase.body: Watch quick demos of desktop controls, hiding shortcuts, and companion chats.

guard.reason: Inserts a new desktop interaction showcase screen after home intro, which is explicitly allowed by onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Supported by 3 support emails, but requires a new screen (cost 0) and finish new_screen has thin single-test evidence.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Interactive Signature Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a centered interactive layout featuring an editable owner sign-off and mascot seal.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drop-off is 25.2% with a long mean duration (1017s). An engaging redesign strengthens emotional ownership prior to wait times.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Sign below to seal your bond with your new desktop companion.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.replace.certificate[0]': a name_input cannot do the certificate job (use ['animation', 'badge', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Home Intro Interactive Desktop Docking Stage
candidates.change: Redesigns the final home intro screen into a stage layout with interactive trial buttons for docking and auto-hiding the pet.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is low (30.5%) and multiple support tickets mention post-onboarding confusion around desktop pet controls.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Try out pet docking and desktop positioning controls before completing setup.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a choice_cards cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Sign-In Account Recovery Diagnostic Flow
candidates.change: Adds an inline account verification helper flow on the sign-in screen to help returning users locate past credentials before authenticating.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing/reset pets upon logging in, and 2 reported sign-in stalls or missing login options.

sign_in.headline: Sign In or Restore Account
sign_in.body: Choose your provider or verify past account email to preserve pet data.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.body' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Desktop Visibility Status Progress Checklist
candidates.change: Adds a detailed system readiness checklist to the waiting screen verifying overlay display, graphics rendering, and window permissions.
candidates.why: Support logged 3 issues where pets failed to render on desktop, and home wait_info components have shown strong test performance.

guard.reason: Adds a system readiness checklist to the waiting screen while keeping its primary function of indicating pet generation.

candidates.score_note: Both funnel duration and 3 support emails point to this issue, matching the reliable home wait_info pattern.

candidates.title: Choose Path Pet Archetype Clarification Hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint on the choose_path screen explaining that chosen pet paths can be customized or switched anytime after setup.
candidates.why: Choose_path has a high mean time (514s) relative to its median (8s), suggesting decision hesitation among stuck users.

choose_path.hint: Don't worry—you can adjust or switch your pet path anytime later in settings.

guard.reason: Adds a clarification hint to the choose path screen without removing options or violating pricing/fair design rules.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path modifications have consistently shown no positive effect or regressed in previous tests.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Render Preview Confirmation Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a render confirmation screen after photo upload, allowing users to verify pet visual feature extraction before adoption.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported that custom pet creation failed or resulted in wrong visual outputs.

new_render_preview.headline: Confirm Pet Appearance
new_render_preview.body: Review your pet's feature rendering before finalizing adoption.

guard.reason: Inserts a valid preview confirmation screen into the onboarding flow after photo upload without removing any existing steps.

candidates.score_note: Backed by 3 support emails on visual errors, but adoption changes lack strong historical backing and require a new screen.

candidates.title: Background Pet Readiness Audio Chime Alert
candidates.change: Adds an option on the waiting screen to sound an audio chime when the desktop pet generation finishes.
candidates.why: The waiting screen mean time is 2336s (approx 38 minutes), showing users minimize the app while waiting and miss completion.

guard.reason: Adds a completion sound chime option to the waiting screen without modifying rules outside onboarding or adding dark patterns.

candidates.score_note: Funnel shows long mean wait duration, but notifications generally showed no clear or negative effect in past tests.
